headline: MOGUL v11.2 — real events affecting market
summary: Real crises now hit four dimensions beyond stocks: valuation, loan rates, consumer demand, branch-closure risk. Multi-year crises persist (1929 → 3-year depression, 2008 → 2-year GFC). Crashes unfold over 30-60 days via delayed shocks. Player can pay for market research — a noised brief on the current crisis + next year's outlook (false neg ~15%, false pos ~10%).
features: Real events 1929/1973/2008/2020 (and more) now modify valuation, rates, demand, closure prob — not just stock prices
Multi-year crises: 1929 lasts 3 years, 2008 lasts 2 — biz/rates/risk/demand carry forward
Stock + deposit shocks split into instant + 30/60-day delayed slices (crashes unfold over weeks)
New market-research action: pay for a brief on the current crisis + next year's outlook (with noise)
Loan interest scales with crisis.rates — debt service balloons during a credit crunch
Branch mood drift applies a demand-drag during crises (e.g. -3%/month at demand 0.7)
Markets tab shows an active-crisis banner + a research panel
Version bumped to v11.2 on homepage + version.json + 10 new engine tests
